content_text_body:
During uncertain and stressful times, your employees need a response plan to help them navigate through tough times.

The goal here is to provide a plan to ensure your team understands how to best manage during a stressful time.

### Develop a plan in response to the current situation
Study up on all the ways your company is responding to the challenge. Customize this plan for your team. If there is no company plan, develop your own response plan. The plan should contain key messages that ensure employees understand how the organization plans to respond to the present situation, what resources and support are available to help individuals and team stay healthy and productive, any new norms that are expected of employees, changes in work schedules or workplace, and where they go to stay abreast of changes.

### Review the plan with your team
Meet frequently with employees and talk through your response plan. Listen carefully to questions and concerns. Share what information you know and commit to getting back promptly with answers you don't know. Invite your team to follow up with you if they have any additional questions or concerns.
